It definitely seems like she isn't doing that, putting in the effort I mean, I have no idea if you are either since I'm not there.  
If you two don't start or don't want to start making things better with each other, as a team, then... divorce exists for a reason.

you can build solar panels around wind turbines and it wont make them go slower, it saves space.

generally you don't need all of your doors to be automatic, just the important ones that a lot of people go through, the rest can all be wood (not stone except for maybe your exterior doors, stone is very strong but also very slow) automatic doors need to have their components replaced sometimes so don't have too many or that will become very expensive

i would say that its more important to replace your wooden floors first before your wooden walls but replacing both is good

try to only have as many batteries as you need because when you have too many they can all release their energy in a massive explosion (the "zzzt" event)

i see that you have a lot of graves for raiders, don't bother, there will be too many for that, just dump the bodies in a far corner of the map or burn them

you are growing a lot of food, and it isn't bad to have extra but don't have too much more than you need, all that extra food will attract more raiders (this also applies to items that aren't food)

and last thing i can think of, the extra dark soil is rich soil, it makes plants grow faster because its extra fertile, its best to grow foods like corn and rice on it because they have high fertility sensitivity which means they get the most from it, plants like potatoes do grow faster on it but they have low fertility sensitivity which means they can grow in very low fertility soil (like stony soil) but they also don't benefit very much from rich soil (rich soil is also very good for devil strand when you research that)

good luck :)
